verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API and an MCP server that expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface as the web app, and says you can "run automated searches with our API." That supports headless, programmatic use, but the evidence is marketing-level and never covers CI integration specifically. Missing for 10: a CLI or CI-oriented tooling, documented auth/API-key handling for non-interactive runs, rate-limit and quota details, CI usage examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.
